about: The configuration schema (roadmap E2): one machine-readable description of the INI fields, the source of the backend's key table (include/Config/ConfigSchemaTable.hh), the GUI's validator data (gui/g4usim_gui/core/config_schema_data.py) and the field tables in docs/功能支持矩阵.md. Regenerate with scripts/generate_config_schema.py; scripts/test_config_schema.py checks that the backend parses every field as written here. Sections are migrated one by one; the backend's own validators stay authoritative.

types.int: a signed 32-bit decimal integer (leading + allowed), checked against min/max
types.string: any single-line text; empty is allowed unless min_length is set
types.enum: one of 'allowed' (or a value_aliases key), any case
types.energy: a number with an optional energy unit (eV, keV, MeV, GeV; '*' between them allowed); unitless means MeV
types.existing_file: empty (none) or a file that exists; relative paths are resolved against the process working directory

fields.empty: "default": an empty value counts as absent (the backend reads it with its string helpers), so the default applies

run.description_zh: 运行参数。CLI 参数（--threads、--seed、--output、--macro 等）优先于这里的值。

threads.description: Number of worker threads; set before Geant4 is initialised
threads.description_zh: worker 线程数；只能在 Geant4 初始化前设置

seed.description: Random seed; when unset the engine chooses (the summary says unknown). Wins over [general] seed
seed.description_zh: 随机数种子；未设置时由引擎决定（摘要写 unknown）。优先于 [general] seed

macro.description: Macro to execute; a relative path is resolved against the working directory and must exist
macro.description_zh: 要执行的 macro；相对路径按进程工作目录解析，文件必须存在

dry_run.description: Check the configuration and write the summary without running events
dry_run.description_zh: 只检查配置并写摘要，不运行事件

verbose.description: Program output level; wins over [general] verbose
verbose.description_zh: 程序输出详细程度；优先于 [general] verbose

check_overlaps.description: Check overlaps when volumes are placed; [geometry] check_overlaps overrides it
check_overlaps.description_zh: 放置体积时检查重叠；[geometry] check_overlaps 会覆盖它

name.description: Run name, written to the summary and metadata
name.description_zh: 运行名称，写入摘要与元数据

general.description_zh: 旧版节，仅为兼容保留；请改用 [run]。

seed.description: Old spelling; ignored when [run] seed is set
seed.description_zh: 旧写法，[run] seed 存在时被忽略

verbose.description: Old spelling; ignored when [run] verbose is set
verbose.description_zh: 旧写法，[run] verbose 存在时被忽略

output.description_zh: 输出位置、格式与粒子径迹。

dir.description: Output folder; empty means output. The --output option wins
dir.description_zh: 输出目录；为空时使用 output。CLI --output 优先

format.description: Scorer output format; root needs a build with ROOT output
format.description_zh: 计分输出格式；root 需要以 ROOT 输出支持构建

trajectories.description: Write every track of the first N events (trajectories_tN.json); 0 = off
trajectories.description_zh: 写出前 N 个事件的全部径迹（trajectories_tN.json）；0 为关闭

trajectory_min_energy.description: Secondary tracks that start below this kinetic energy are not written (primaries always are)
trajectory_min_energy.description_zh: 低于此初始动能的次级径迹不写出（初级总是写出）

trajectory_max_points.description: Point limit per trajectory file; the file is truncated and marked beyond it
trajectory_max_points.description_zh: 每个径迹文件的点数上限，超过后截断并标记
